en: So you're the one the old man keeps talking about. I've come a long way for a battle like this!
A Champion, here? Then I didn't cross the sea for nothing. Let's see what you've got!
I trained every day on the way here. I hope you're ready, because I am!
Superb! What a battle that was. These old eyes haven't seen the like in years!
Oh, too bad! Still, you fought well. There's always another day.
That was a battle to remember! I'll be on my way soon. Thank you.
